purpose: Code-driven appearance-memory state control; no network fit or novelty claim
selection_rule: First 12 fit source groups by SHA256(context_feature_memory_smoke_v1 NUL source_group), all selected nonempty videos and all their chronological cached retained frames; no outcomes used

mode_definitions.released: Original released tracker path, same cached inputs
mode_definitions.raw_confidence: Separate raw appearance EMA only for appearance consistency; original fused scoring memory retained
mode_definitions.raw_only: No feature fusion, raw identity EMA scoring
mode_definitions.raw_store_one_sided: Store raw identity EMA, fuse current only for scoring
mode_definitions.raw_store_symmetric: Store raw identity EMA; transient key/reference fusion computed bidirectionally from same raw pre-update context

feature_precision: Saved track_feats256 and cls_feats512 are float16, convert to CPU float32. This cannot guarantee exact original float32/GPU baseline. Report original-vs-replay canonical partition and row ID differences per video; all method comparisons condition on same quantized cache.
replay_boundary: All retained post-distractor rows, including id=-1 if any; fixed order, geometry, score and emitted class. Empty frames still update/expire memo. Pre-filtered entrypoint skips only original distractor operation.
scoring: Seal all 5 mode predictions before any supervised join. Only eligible fit146 exact manual-anchor observation identities, attached by image_id and dump_row after verifying original observation provenance. Rebuild all new-ID partitions, do not use original predicted-track edge/pair subsets. Unknown identity stays outside scoring, report coverage; new id=-1 is a unique singleton and explicitly counted on same denominator.
metrics: Source -> (video,official_GT_identity) -> unique observation equal weights; BCubed precision/recall then harmonic F1. Report each source, all modes and coverage. No bootstrap or model selection for 12-source smoke.
interpretation: No official TETA/AssocA, no full val/test, no efficacy/generalization or train-readiness claim. This is a sparse-anchor quantized feature-replay diagnostic.
